question_text: When have you worked towards an ambitious goal? As part of your answer, please describe how you tackled this goal, what set backs you faced and what energised you about the situation. (500 words)
sample_answer: One vivid example of working towards an ambitious goal was when I set out to develop my own adventure video game from scratch. Captivated by storytelling and the immersive worlds of games since childhood, I was inspired to create a game that offered not just entertainment but a deep, emotionally engaging experience through intricate character development and dynamic narratives. Embarking on this project without formal training in game or software design was a significant undertaking. Driven by the desire to bring my vision to life, I recognised it would require me to self-learn a multitude of complex skills. The game I envisioned featured a richly detailed world with numerous interactive characters, each influencing the storyline in meaningful ways based on player choices. Faced with the challenge of mastering new programming languages, understanding game development frameworks, and learning graphic design independently, I adopted a structured approach to self-learning. Immersing myself in online tutorials, webinars, and developer forums, I broke down the development process into manageable steps with clear milestones. This methodical approach allowed me to build a solid foundation in programming and game design principles. A significant setback occurred when I encountered performance issues during testing phases involving complex character interactions. The frame rate dropped noticeably, causing lag and detracting from the player experience. Improving the game's performance without compromising its rich content was critical. To overcome this hurdle, I delved into optimisation techniques such as object pooling to manage resources efficiently, level-of-detail adjustments to reduce processing loads, and refining code to eliminate unnecessary calculations. Another challenge was integrating Python scripts to handle advanced computational tasks, despite Unity primarily using C+. This presented compatibility issues like misaligned data types leading to real-time errors. I researched and implemented a middleware solution that standardised data types between Python and Unity, enabling efficient data transfer and processing. This not only resolved the compatibility issues but also significantly enhanced the game's performance. What energised me throughout this journey was witnessing the tangible progress of my creation. Each obstacle overcome and improvement made—whether in performance optimisation or storyline enhancement—fuelled my motivation to tackle the next challenge. Collaborating with other developers in online communities such as Discord, provided valuable insights and fostered a sense of camaraderie, which was especially encouraging during difficult phases. Releasing the demo version was an incredibly rewarding milestone. Receiving positive feedback from players who appreciated the seamless character interactions and engaging gameplay validated the hard work and long hours invested. I managed to increase the frame rate by approximately 30%, significantly enhancing the smoothness of gameplay during complex interactions. This experience highlighted the importance of independent learning, adaptability, and resilience. It honed my technical and problem-solving skills and reinforced my confidence in tackling ambitious goals without formal instruction. I am eager to bring these attributes to Eversheds, confident that my ability to learn independently and think creatively will contribute to delivering practical, tailored solutions for clients.

Setbacks are overcome through technical optimisation and creative interoperability solutions
Progress, community collaboration, and validated outcomes sustain motivation

question_text: Describe the achievement or accomplishment are you most proud of and why. Use the space below to explain how you challenged yourself in the process, if you had to overcome any setbacks and the skills you used to achieve this. (300 words)
sample_answer: The accomplishment I am most proud of is delivering a TEDx talk on the importance of gender equality in education during high school. Speaking to a large audience on a subject I cared deeply about was both exciting and daunting, requiring me to push past my comfort zone, overcome self-doubt, and develop essential skills that I continue to use today. Preparing for the talk was an intense and rewarding process. I spent weeks researching, writing, and rehearsing to ensure my arguments were compelling and my delivery confident. Balancing this with my academic and extracurricular commitments was challenging, but it taught me how to manage my time effectively and stay organized under pressure. Constructive feedback during rehearsals often forced me to rework my presentation, which taught me the value of resilience and the importance of adapting to improve. On the day of the talk, I faced my nerves head-on. My experience as President of my school's Debate Society and Chair of the Cambridge Model United Nations helped me stay calm and focused, as I had developed skills in public speaking and engaging an audience. Standing on that stage, I focused on sharing my message clearly and persuasively, determined to inspire others to think critically about the role of education in achieving gender equality. Successfully delivering the talk was not just a personal triumph but also a chance to spark meaningful conversations on an issue I am passionate about. This experience pushed me to grow both personally and professionally. It strengthened my confidence, resilience, and ability to communicate under pressure, skills that I know will serve me well in my legal career. I am proud of this achievement because it demonstrates how hard work and determination can create opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

Upon completing the client query, I would proceed to the remaining tasks, adhering to my priority list while ensuring outstanding emails are addressed—all without compromising quality. My experience managing multiple responsibilities as a full-time student working part-time and involved in various volunteering commitments has honed my time-management skills, allowing me to handle competing demands effectively. I remain solution-focused and composed under pressure to perceive challenges from unique perspectives and implement creative solutions. Although challenging, this scenario is energising as it offers growth opportunities, enabling me to harness my skills to bring unique perspectives to problem-solving. question_text: Please choose a current legal issue that interests you and describe how it affects/may affect the current legal market? (approx. 300 words max)
sample_answer: With the rise of digital technology, most valuable data is now stored digitally. In turn, cybercriminals have increasingly exploited this trend by targeting businesses' digital sources for confidential information and intelligence. According to the SRA report, cybercrime was the most prevalent crime in 2017. Subsequently, this has been a key driver in the increased focus on cybersecurity, the protection of computer systems from being stolen, harmed or being compromised in a cyberattack. As the threat of cybersecurity is ever more imminent, this has, and can further impact the current legal market in various ways. For example, this can pose as a business opportunity for law firms; in case of such breaches happening, businesses will require legal advice. Thus, law firms with a strong sector knowledge of technology and cybersecurity are likely to benefit. However, firms that lack in this specific sector may improve their position within the wider market by strengthening their practices by recruiting specialist lawyers or by investing in internal training. However, as law firms have increasingly adopted legal technology, they have also become vulnerable to such cyberattacks. This can have significant economic impact: compensation for losing client data and reduction in productivity, thus loss of billable hours, can cause high immediate costs. Additionally, a cyberattack on a law firm can create reputational damage, leading to long-term loss of work. Therefore, firms need to ensure they have the appropriate softwares in place to make both client protection and self-preservation at the heart of their businesses.
